field-never-sent.message: `priority` is read by BuildBot.handleJobQueued on build_updates (JOB_QUEUED) and sent by none of its publishers
field-never-sent.evidence: every sender on the crossing and every reader of it was read

answer-field-never-returned.message: `rating` of the answer to GET /stores/:param is read by StorePage and never returned: GET /stores/:param answers StoreCard (id, name, address)
answer-field-never-returned.evidence: the route answers a shape read whole, and the field is not in it
answer-field-never-returned.fix: return `rating` from GET /stores/:param, or stop reading it

type-never-published.message: handleLive handles ORDER_REFUNDED, which nothing publishes on the 2 channels it receives (shop:*:events, shop:*:orders); their 4 publish(es) send ALERT_RAISED, AUDIT_ENTRY_CREATED, ORDER_PLACED, ORDER_SHIPPED
type-never-published.evidence: every channel it receives was read, and every publish on each says the type it sends

contract-break.message: sender back-office sends `priceTier` as `string`; receiver stores-api declares it `number`

message-type-unselected.message: no code that runs selects ORDER_SHIPPED on shop:*:orders: 2 consumers choose other types (handleFeed, handleLive)

message-type-unselected.why: handleFeed chooses ALERT_RAISED, and 1 subscription(s) behind GET /shops/:param/feed name a channel not read

type-never-published.why: 1 subscription(s) behind GET /shops/:param/feed name a channel not read

config-not-set.why: no deployment file of back-office was read: its settings may be set where the reading does not look

field-never-sent.why: `attempt` is compared under a type said two ways (BuildBot.handleBuildRetry: its parameter's type says BUILD_RETRIED; the code that calls it does so for BUILD_FAILED)

answer-field-never-returned.why: 1: what GET /categories/tree answers is not a shape read, so the fields its clients read were not compared; 2: `changesFromPrevious` is read behind a check that it is there (changeSummary, line 27): the client handles its absence
